en.hubeali: Some of our companions, from the one who mentioned it, from Ibn Mahboub, from Umar Bin Aban Al Kalby, from Al Mufazzal Bin Umar who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘When (Syeda) Aamina<sup>as</sup> was blessed with Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, there were opened up (displayed) for, the white (houses) of Persian, and palaces of Syria (as having been conquered).

So (Syeda) Fatima<sup>asws</sup> Bint Asad<sup>as</sup>, mother<sup>asws</sup> of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> came over to Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup>, smiling, giving glad tidings, and let him<sup>asws</sup> know what Aamina<sup>asws</sup> had said.

So Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup> said to her<sup>asws</sup>: ‘You<sup>asws</sup> are being astounded from this? You<sup>asws</sup> would be blessed with and bring up his<sup>saww</sup> successor<sup>asws</sup> and his<sup>saww</sup> Vizier’.
